_warning: DO NOT EDIT — AUTO-GENERATED FILE. Source of truth lives in a_solutions/*/build.json + config.json + b_infra/*/build.json. Edits here are overwritten on every `bash 1_configs/build.sh all`.

url_health._comment: cloud-url-health-report runtime config. Passwords NEVER live here — NOREPLY_PASSWORD + ME_PASSWORD come from env (sops-decrypted upstream).

concurrency._comment: Private concurrency intentionally low: 16 simultaneous WG probes saturate idle handshakes and cause cascading timeouts on the spokes. 4 is high-enough for the 86 private targets to finish in <30s while staying under the WG renegotiation pressure point.

timeouts._comment: Bumped 2026-05-07: WG re-handshake on idle peers can take ~3-5s before first packet, so a 3s TCP / 5s HTTP-total budget produced false negatives across the 10.0.0.6 spoke (oci-apps) when probing from desktop. New budget allows one full handshake + actual request.

targets._comment: Ports that are not HTTP servers — probe via TcpStream::connect only, skip HTTP GET.

jmap._comment: WG-direct to Stalwart on oci-mail (10.0.0.3:2443) — same transport as the IMAP leg. The public jmap.diegonmarcos.com edge is unreachable/slow from the CI runner.

workflows._comment: Declarative config for the workflow-status audit in reports. Fire rule 3: no hardcoded repo/host names in engine code. Consumed by cloud-health-full-daily (GHA + Dagu fetchers). Evidence goes to reports-logs/dist/workflows/.

checks.description: Only failures within `window_hours` appear in report
Code does not hardcode any of the repos from this JSON

repo_scan._comment: cloud-sec-data-report::repo_scan config. Zero VM CPU — laptop-local. `~/git/vault/` NEVER scanned: intentional secrets store.
repo_scan._activation_script_patterns_re_comment: Filename patterns identifying ACTIVATION / PROVISIONING scripts. Any content-pattern match inside these files is auto-elevated to CRITICAL — fire rule 3: scripts MUST be data-driven. Anything with a hardcoded password/token/key is P0.

sec_scan._comment: cloud-sec-data-report runtime config. docker_cp_fallback OFF — never load CPU on slow VMs.

pipeline.description: Two-stage build: consolidator merges all build.json + config.json sources into the master file; derive emits per-container + archived split files from the master.
source_inputs: vault/secrets.yaml (sops-encrypted secrets per service, key names extracted)

outputs.per_container: 1_cloud-configs/dist/build-{container_or_service_name}.json (one per container, plus one per container-less service — derive output)
outputs.archived: 1_configs/dist/z_archive/cloud-data-{slice}.json (deprecated split files — kept for soft-transition fallbacks; consumers should read consolidated instead)
